model.title: To designate the facility of the United States Postal Service located at 6444 San Fernando Road in Glendale, California, as the "Paul Ignatius Post Office".
model.meta: Homeland Security and Governmental Affairs Committee, Oversight and Government Reform Committee · Rep. Laura Friedman (D-CA)

summary.text: The bill would rename the U.S. Postal Service facility located at 6444 San Fernando Road in Glendale, California, as the "Paul Ignatius Post Office."
